## Design

### 2026-10-17 – I havent made much project, but I'm planning to lock in on this last day.I finished creating 6 different tracks, 2 straight curved tracks, a spiral downward track, a 45 degree downslope after a straig

**1.28h**

I havent made much project, but I'm planning to lock in on this last day.I finished creating 6 different tracks, 2 straight curved tracks, a spiral downward track, a 45 degree downslope after a straight strack and the funnel track from the starter tutorial. I'm now currently working on the path where you put the 3 marbls because I want it to be an actual marble race, not just a track

### 2026-10-18 – **Progress steady!**

**5.1h**

**Progress steady!**
  Made a couple more special / experimental tracks from the guide and some i found online on other marble tracks. So I made a plinko track, a hole box part,  a spiral track with just over 2 revolutions, and finished the start track (all pictures under ↓).

  It took me a while to fix a lot of problems especially with startstrack because I didn't know how to get rid of the overlap from 3 tracks merging into one but I got it done eventually. for the spiral i did it wrong first then AI told me how to do it using a helix because I was doing some nonsense before😭.I adjusted the funnel component to have the starts of the track. Because if it was the platform under it then the max size of 150x150x4mm is WAYY too small, the funnel track alone would take like 80% of the xy space lol.
